evidence.excerpt: Ivković prefers industry collaborations that can produce publishable results or student thesis topics alongside commercial deliverables. He is particularly interested in partners who can provide longitudinal interaction logs, as most of his current datasets are limited in temporal depth. He has no planned sabbatical in the next two years.
